description: Get All Sequences - Retrieve all sequences with optional filtering. Note: boolean filters (starred/archived) and owned_by are unreliable. Supported filters: search, status, folder, sortBy, sortType, sendAll.

limit.description: Maximum number of sequences to return (default: 100, max 100)

search.description: Search query to filter sequences by name

sendAll.description: Include both archived and active sequences

skip.description: Number of sequences to skip for pagination (default: 0)

status.description: Filter sequences by status: running, paused, completed, or needs-attention

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: get_all_sequences

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Get All Sequences
